name: express-addon-review
description: Reviews an Adobe Express add-on against Adobe's current docs before submission: scans the code, walks the panel at 320px in light and dark, fixes what it finds, and prepares the listing screenshots. Follow along on a live local dashboard or in chat.
author: express-addon-review
install: npx skills add ThisIsMrAli/addon-developer-assistant --skill express-addon-review --skill express-addon-develop -a {{platform}}
